concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: a swiftness tonic. A slim tall elegant glass bottle filled with bright sky-blue liquid, with a pale glass stopper shaped like a pair of small swept-back feathered wings on top, a thin silver band around the neck, flat round base so it stands upright. Light, airy, fast-looking. About 0.38 m tall. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN: slim tall bottle, bright sky-blue liquid, frosted glass winged stopper, silver neck band; 3 consistent views

agent_visual_verdict: Good: slim tall bottle with bright sky-blue liquid panel, pale frosted winged stopper (both wings intact, readable silhouette), silver-grey neck band and round foot. Glass is opaque pale green-grey (Meshy bakes no transparency); a refraction/emissive material on the liquid is an integration choice. 0.14 x 0.38 x 0.09 m.
